units: AZN, minutes (offer level), per hour (rates), Wh, km
tolerance: 1e-6 absolute after rounding to 6 decimals; strings/lists exact

g_prior.label: PRIOR
g_prior.basis: Wolt AZ statement 5-6 AZN/h (2022, web-wolt-az:W1) minus ~1.0-1.5 AZN/h variable cost; Bolt marketing 'up to 7 AZN/h' (B11) as upper bound; synthetic sim fixed points 4.1-6.4 (unlimited energy) and 3.0-4.3 (one battery). Not the courier's data.

wolt.label: PRIOR
wolt.basis: 2.8 km at ~17.5 km/h + ~5 min wait + ~2 min handoff ~= 17 min vs midpoint 12 (assumption)

bolt.label: PRIOR
bolt.basis: Bolt '22 min' = 8 + 14 travel ETAs (B16) so service time is excluded; +5 min wait +3 min handoff ~= 30/22

km_scope_factor.label: PRIOR
km_scope_factor.basis: ride km / shown km when the shown scope is unknown (W2/W10: approach is paid, scope of '2.8 km' unknown)

bolt_display_kmh.label: PRIOR
bolt_display_kmh.basis: speed implied by Bolt ETAs; sim assumption, unverified

detour.label: PRIOR
detour.basis: road km / straight-line km, sim assumption

wh_per_km.label: PRIOR
wh_per_km.basis: heavy urban courier 15-17 Wh/km, crowd mean 13.5 (web-scooter:S6)

cost.label: PRIOR (web-scooter:S19 typical; tyre/pad life, depreciation and Baku battery price unverified)

battery_season_factor.label: PRIOR
battery_season_factor.basis: Sandia NMC 15C 2-3x worse cycling; Schmalstieg calendar Ea 58 kJ/mol (S11-S13)

hour_block_mult.label: PRIOR; peak times from Wolt AZ FAQ 11:45-15:00 and 18:00-21:30 (W11), magnitudes invented

d_prior_weight.label: DESIGN hedge while zone rates are priors

p_acc.label: PRIOR (share of free-time offers the policy accepts)

wolt_K_support.label: SCENARIO: only the existence of 'set offline ... for declining too many' is evidenced (W6)

substitution_other_app.label: PRIOR: share of g kept while one app is offline and the other is online

bolt_ar_floor.label: UNVERIFIED: Bolt help says the required rate varies by market (80% or 40%); 0.80 is the conservative default, user-settable (B7)

stack.label: PRIOR/SCENARIO (sim proxy; platform tolerance unknown). USER 2026-10-07: never carries two orders at once, so only 'append' (finish A, then B) is evaluated unless allowInterleave is set

documented_window_ms.label: UPPER BOUND, not verified for Wolt AZ: the '60 s' text is in Wolt's UZB FAQ (W5 skeptic); Wolt partner-app pages say 30-60 s; Bolt help 'one minute' (B8). Measure on the phone

safety.label: DESIGN defaults; user-adjustable; not legal limits

score_levels.label: DESIGN defaults for the multi-score card; not a verdict; user-tunable
